mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, s.session_id AS sessionId, sku.sku_id AS skuId, p.project_status AS projectStatus, s.session_status AS sessionStatus, sku.sku_status AS skuStatus, s.delivery_type AS deliveryType, s.limit_per_order AS limitPerOrder, sku.sku_name AS skuName, sku.price AS localUnitPrice, sku.price_mode AS priceMode, sku.stock_available AS localStockAvailable, sku.inventory_authority AS inventoryAuthority, tsp.provider_id AS providerId, tsp.provider_code AS providerCode, pm.mapping_id AS projectMappingId, smap.mapping_id AS sessionMappingId, skum.mapping_id AS skuMappingId, pm.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, smap.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId, skum.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, skum.inventory_mode AS inventoryMode FROM ticket_sku sku JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = sku.project_id JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = sku.session_id AND s.project_id = p.project_id JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping skum ON skum.sku_id = sku.sku_id AND skum.mapping_status = 'BOUND' JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping smap ON smap.mapping_id = skum.session_mapping_id AND smap.mapping_status = 'BOUND' JOIN ticket_source_project_mapping pm ON pm.mapping_id = smap.project_mapping_id AND pm.mapping_status = 'BOUND' JOIN ticket_source_provider tsp ON tsp.provider_id = skum.provider_id AND tsp.provider_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND sku.sku_id IN #{skuId} ORDER BY FIELD(sku.sku_id, #{skuId})

SELECT q.quote_id AS quoteId,q.user_id AS userId,q.provider_id AS providerId,p.provider_code AS providerCode, q.project_id AS projectId,q.session_id AS sessionId,q.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, q.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId,q.purchase_mode AS purchaseMode,q.ticket_mode AS ticketMode, q.delivery_mode AS deliveryMode,q.address_id AS addressId,q.face_amount AS faceAmount, q.ticket_amount AS ticketAmount,q.provider_ticket_amount AS providerTicketAmount, q.provider_discount_amount AS providerDiscountAmount,q.provider_pay_amount AS providerPayAmount, q.settlement_amount AS settlementAmount,q.discount_amount AS discountAmount, q.delivery_fee_amount AS deliveryFeeAmount,q.service_fee_amount AS serviceFeeAmount,q.pay_amount AS payAmount, q.provider_delivery_quote_id AS providerDeliveryQuoteId,q.request_snapshot AS requestSnapshot, q.items_snapshot AS itemsSnapshot,q.promotion_snapshot AS promotionSnapshot,q.expire_time AS expireTime, q.used_order_id AS usedOrderId FROM ticket_source_order_quote q JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=q.provider_id WHERE q.quote_id=#{quoteId} AND q.user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_order_quote SET used_order_id=#{orderId},update_time=NOW() WHERE quote_id=#{quoteId} AND used_order_id IS NULL AND expire_time>NOW()

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET provider_order_id=#{providerOrderId},provider_order_no=#{providerOrderNo},bridge_status='RESERVED', provider_order_status=#{providerOrderStatus},reservation_expire_time=#{reservationExpireTime}, provider_create_time=#{providerCreateTime},last_operation='CREATE_ORDER',last_sync_status='SUCCESS', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0,response_snapshot=#{responseSnapshot}, unknown_result_since=NULL,last_recovery_time=NOW(), version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('INITIATING','FAILED','UNKNOWN_RESULT','MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='UNKNOWN_RESULT',last_operation='CREATE_ORDER_LOOKUP',last_sync_status='PENDING', last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},last_error_retryable=#{retryable}, unknown_result_since=COALESCE(unknown_result_since,NOW()),create_recovery_attempts=0,last_recovery_time=NULL, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('INITIATING','UNKNOWN_RESULT')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status=CASE WHEN create_recovery_attempts >= (#{manualReviewThreshold} - 1) THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW' ELSE 'UNKNOWN_RESULT' END, create_recovery_attempts=LEAST(create_recovery_attempts+1, #{manualReviewThreshold}), last_recovery_time=NOW(), last_operation='CREATE_ORDER_LOOKUP',last_sync_status='FAILED', last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},last_error_retryable=#{retryable}, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('UNKNOWN_RESULT','MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status=IF(#{retryable},'FAILED','FAILED'),last_operation='CREATE_ORDER',last_sync_status='FAILED', last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},last_error_retryable=#{retryable}, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
UPDATE ticket_order SET order_status='CANCELED',cancel_time=#{cancelTime},update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='WAIT_PAY'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status=#{bridgeStatus},provider_order_id=#{providerOrderId},provider_order_no=#{providerOrderNo}, provider_order_status=#{providerOrderStatus},provider_create_time=COALESCE(#{providerCreateTime},provider_create_time), last_operation='CREATE_ORDER_LOOKUP',last_sync_status='SUCCESS',last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL, last_error_retryable=0,response_snapshot=#{responseSnapshot},last_recovery_time=NOW(), version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('UNKNOWN_RESULT','MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_submit_idempotency SET submit_status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND submit_status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN_RESULT','MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='MANUAL_REVIEW', provider_order_status=COALESCE(#{providerOrderStatus},provider_order_status), last_operation=#{operation},last_sync_status='FAILED', last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},last_error_retryable=0, response_snapshot=COALESCE(#{responseSnapshot},response_snapshot), version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.client_submit_no AS clientSubmitNo,i.submit_status AS submitStatus,i.error_code AS submitErrorCode, i.error_message AS submitErrorMessage,i.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo,o.user_id AS userId,o.order_status AS localOrderStatus,o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, b.bridge_status AS bridgeStatus,b.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId,b.provider_order_status AS providerOrderStatus, b.last_operation AS lastOperation,b.last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus, b.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode,b.last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage, b.unknown_result_since AS unknownResultSince,b.create_recovery_attempts AS createRecoveryAttempts, b.last_recovery_time AS lastRecoveryTime,b.create_idempotency_key AS createIdempotencyKey FROM ticket_source_submit_idempotency i LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge b ON b.order_id=i.order_id WHERE i.client_submit_no=#{clientSubmitNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo,o.user_id AS userId,o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus,o.fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode,o.pay_amount AS payAmount, b.pay_amount AS providerPayAmount,o.pay_expire_time AS payExpireTime,b.bridge_id AS bridgeId, b.provider_id AS providerId,p.provider_code AS providerCode,b.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId, b.bridge_status AS bridgeStatus,b.provider_order_status AS providerOrderStatus, b.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId,b.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId, b.create_idempotency_key AS createIdempotencyKey,b.payment_idempotency_key AS paymentIdempotencyKey, b.cancel_idempotency_key AS cancelIdempotencyKey,b.create_recovery_attempts AS createRecoveryAttempts, b.unknown_result_since AS unknownResultSince,b.last_recovery_time AS lastRecoveryTime,b.last_operation AS lastOperation,q.delivery_mode AS deliveryMode FROM ticket_order o JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge b ON b.order_id=o.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=b.provider_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_order_quote q ON q.quote_id=b.quote_id WHERE o.order_id=#{orderId} AND b.order_model='SINGLE_SKU' LIMIT 1

SELECT order_id FROM ticket_source_order_bridge WHERE bridge_status='UNKNOWN_RESULT' AND order_model='SINGLE_SKU' AND COALESCE(last_recovery_time,unknown_result_since,update_time) <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_recovery_time,unknown_result_since,update_time) ASC, order_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_submit_idempotency SET submit_status='SUCCESS',order_id=#{orderId},error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND submit_status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN_RESULT','MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_submit_idempotency SET submit_status='MANUAL_REVIEW',error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND submit_status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN_RESULT','MANUAL_REVIEW')
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId,o.order_no AS orderNo,o.user_id AS userId,o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus,o.fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode,o.pay_amount AS payAmount, b.pay_amount AS providerPayAmount, o.pay_expire_time AS payExpireTime,b.bridge_id AS bridgeId,b.provider_id AS providerId, p.provider_code AS providerCode,b.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId,b.bridge_status AS bridgeStatus, b.provider_order_status AS providerOrderStatus,b.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, b.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId,b.create_idempotency_key AS createIdempotencyKey, b.payment_idempotency_key AS paymentIdempotencyKey,b.cancel_idempotency_key AS cancelIdempotencyKey, b.create_recovery_attempts AS createRecoveryAttempts,b.unknown_result_since AS unknownResultSince, b.last_recovery_time AS lastRecoveryTime,b.last_operation AS lastOperation,q.delivery_mode AS deliveryMode FROM ticket_order o JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge b ON b.order_id=o.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=b.provider_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_order_quote q ON q.quote_id=b.quote_id WHERE o.order_id=#{orderId} AND o.user_id=#{userId} AND b.order_model='SINGLE_SKU' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.bridge_id AS bridgeId,b.order_item_id AS orderItemId,oi.sku_id AS skuId,b.sku_mapping_id AS skuMappingId, b.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId,b.quantity AS quantity,b.provider_unit_price AS providerUnitPrice, b.settlement_unit_price AS settlementUnitPrice FROM ticket_source_order_item_bridge b JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_item_id=b.order_item_id WHERE b.bridge_id=#{bridgeId} ORDER BY b.bridge_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='PAYMENT_CONFIRMING',last_operation='CONFIRM_PAYMENT', last_sync_status='PENDING',version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status='RESERVED'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='RESERVED',last_sync_status='FAILED', last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},last_error_retryable=#{retryable}, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status='PAYMENT_CONFIRMING'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='PAID',provider_order_status=#{providerOrderStatus}, provider_pay_time=#{providerPayTime},last_operation='CONFIRM_PAYMENT',last_sync_status='SUCCESS', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0,response_snapshot=#{responseSnapshot}, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId}

UPDATE ticket_order SET order_status='WAIT_USE',payment_status='PROVIDER_CONFIRMED',pay_method=#{payMethod}, pay_time=#{payTime},update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='WAIT_PAY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO electronic_ticket (ticket_no,order_id,order_item_id,order_audience_id,ticket_status,qr_code_value,seat_info,generate_time,check_time,expire_time,abnormal_reason,create_time,update_time) SELECT CONCAT('V11ET',DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s'),oa.order_audience_id), oa.order_id,oa.order_item_id,oa.order_audience_id,'GENERATING',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NOW(),NOW() FROM order_audience oa JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=oa.order_id WHERE oa.order_id=#{orderId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM electronic_ticket et WHERE et.order_audience_id=oa.order_audience_id)

INSERT IGNORE INTO ticket_source_issue_task (order_id,bridge_id,provider_id,provider_order_id,task_status,provider_delivery_status,expected_ticket_count, issued_count,failed_count,retry_count,max_retry_count,issue_idempotency_key,request_sent,manual_hold, next_attempt_time,last_operation,create_time,update_time) SELECT o.order_id,b.bridge_id,b.provider_id,b.provider_order_id,'PENDING','UNKNOWN',COUNT(oa.order_audience_id), 0,0,0,5,CONCAT('FULFILL:',o.order_no),0,0,NOW(),'CREATE_AFTER_PAYMENT',NOW(),NOW() FROM ticket_order o JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge b ON b.order_id=o.order_id JOIN order_audience oa ON oa.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_id=#{orderId} AND o.fulfillment_mode='TICKET_SOURCE' AND b.order_model='SINGLE_SKU' AND b.provider_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.order_id,b.bridge_id,b.provider_id,b.provider_order_id,o.order_no
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='CANCELING',last_operation='CANCEL_ORDER', last_sync_status='PENDING',version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status='RESERVED'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='RESERVED',last_sync_status='FAILED', last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},last_error_retryable=#{retryable}, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status='CANCELING'

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status=#{bridgeStatus},provider_order_status=#{providerOrderStatus}, provider_cancel_time=#{providerCancelTime},last_operation='CANCEL_ORDER',last_sync_status='SUCCESS', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0,response_snapshot=#{responseSnapshot}, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
UPDATE ticket_order SET order_status='CANCELED',cancel_time=#{cancelTime},update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='WAIT_PAY'

UPDATE ticket_sku SET stock_available=CASE WHEN #{availableStock} <= stock_locked THEN 0 ELSE #{availableStock} - stock_locked END, sku_status=CASE WHEN #{sourceSaleStatus}='SOLD_OUT' OR #{availableStock}=0 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' WHEN #{sourceSaleStatus}='PRESALE' THEN 'PRESALE' WHEN #{sourceSaleStatus}='ON_SALE' THEN 'ON_SALE' ELSE sku_status END, update_time=NOW() WHERE sku_id=#{skuId}

UPDATE ticket_sku SET sku_status=CASE WHEN #{sourceSaleStatus}='SOLD_OUT' THEN 'SOLD_OUT' WHEN #{sourceSaleStatus}='PRESALE' THEN 'PRESALE' WHEN #{sourceSaleStatus}='ON_SALE' THEN 'ON_SALE' ELSE sku_status END, update_time=NOW() WHERE sku_id=#{skuId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_audience WHERE order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT pm.project_id AS projectId,sm.session_id AS sessionId,skm.sku_id AS skuId,sku.sku_name AS skuName, sku.price AS localPrice,sku.price_mode AS priceMode,sku.stock_available AS localStock,sku.sku_status AS localSkuStatus, ps.delivery_type AS deliveryType,p.provider_code AS providerCode, pm.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId,pm.mapping_status AS projectMappingStatus, sm.provider_session_id AS providerSessionId,sm.mapping_status AS sessionMappingStatus, skm.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId,skm.provider_sku_name AS providerSkuName,skm.mapping_status AS skuMappingStatus, skm.source_sale_status AS sourceSaleStatus,skm.inventory_mode AS inventoryMode, skm.available_stock_snapshot AS availableStockSnapshot,skm.face_price AS providerFacePrice, skm.sale_price AS providerSalePrice,skm.settlement_price AS settlementPrice, skm.last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus,skm.last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime FROM ticket_source_project_mapping pm JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=pm.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_session_mapping sm ON sm.project_mapping_id=pm.mapping_id JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping skm ON skm.session_mapping_id=sm.mapping_id JOIN ticket_sku sku ON sku.sku_id=skm.sku_id JOIN performance_session ps ON ps.session_id=sm.session_id WHERE p.provider_code=#{providerCode} AND pm.provider_project_id=#{providerProjectId} AND pm.mapping_status='BOUND' AND sm.mapping_status='BOUND' AND skm.mapping_status='BOUND' ORDER BY sm.provider_session_id,skm.provider_sku_id
